AppError.description: The app refused the call (`APP_ERROR`, one of its declared errors) or the run trapped (`TRAP`).

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed (`BAD_REQUEST`), names a reserved method (`RESERVED_METHOD`), or carries an approval for another call (`WRONG_CHALLENGE`).

ConfirmRequired.description: `CONFIRM_REQUIRED`: approve the call with the passkey and send it again with `confirm`.

Forbidden.description: The caller may not call this method of this app (`FORBIDDEN`), or the app is read-only.

Gone.description: `UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE`: the app is an SDK 0.12 app, which this node no longer runs.

RateLimited.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: a public method's rate, or the node's limits.

Unauthorized.description: No valid session or API key, and the method is not public.

Unavailable.description: `UNAVAILABLE` or `TIMEOUT`: retry with the same idempotency key.

idempotencyKey.description: A retry with the same key is answered once, from the first run.

events.description: The events the call emitted that the caller is in the audience of.

index.description: The log index the answer reflects.

Confirm.description: The passkey's approval of this exact call: the 412's challenge id and the WebAuthn assertion over its challenge.

session.description: A passkey session's token or an API key, as `Authorization: Bearer`, inside the sealed channel.

info.description: Generated from the app's ABI (its `calimero:abi` section). Every request and answer travels inside the node's sealed channel, after the client has verified the node's attestation: use mero-js or calimero-client-py as the transport (the typed clients `meroctl app codegen` writes do), not plain HTTP. `POST /apps/{app}/methods/{name}` runs exactly as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` (a call) or `POST /apps/{app}/views` (a view) with the same `method`: the same authentication, gating, passkey step-up and limits. Errors are `{ error, message, details }`.
info.title: mero-sign

get.description: Server-sent events: the committed events from log index `from`, then live ones. Each frame's `event` is the event's name, `id` is `<index>:<seq>` and `data` its fields as JSON. A subscriber receives only the events it is in the audience of.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "addParticipant"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Adds an account of the organization (guests included) at `permission`.
Admins only (`Forbidden`); `Conflict` for a participant (use
`setParticipantPermission`), `Invalid` for an account outside the
organization. Clears an earlier removal. Emits `ParticipantJoined`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "createSignature"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Saves a signature image the caller uploaded as blob `blobIdStr` and
returns its id (below 2^53). Private library, owner only.
Emits `SignatureCreated`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "deleteDocument"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Deletes a document with its search content, signatures and consents.
Admins only (`Forbidden`); `NotFound` for an unknown id. The blobs stay
in the app until the owner deletes them. Emits `DocumentDeleted`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "deleteSignature"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Deletes a saved signature. Private library, owner only; `NotFound` for
an unknown id. Emits `SignatureDeleted`.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "getContextDetails"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
The agreement's name, owner, participants (at most 1,000) and document
count. `contextIdStr` is echoed back as `contextId`.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "getContextId"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: This instance's app id (v1's context id).

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "getDocumentSignatures"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
The signatures on a document, in the order they were applied; empty
for an unknown document.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "getIdentityMapping"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
The identity mapping recorded for a joined agreement. Private library,
owner only; `NotFound` if none.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "getSharedIdentity"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
The shared identity recorded for a joined agreement. Private library,
owner only; `NotFound` if none.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "getUserPermission"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: A participant's level; `NotFound` for someone who is not one.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "hasConsented"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Whether `userIdStr` consented to sign a document.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "isDefaultPrivateContext"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Whether this is the account's default private library (set up private
and named `"default"`). `false` before `setup`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "joinSharedContext"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.

A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "leaveSharedContext"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Forgets a joined agreement. Private library, owner only; `NotFound` if
it was not recorded. Emits `ContextLeft`.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "listDocuments"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Every document (at most 1,000, in id order) with its current version
and status, without its search content.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "listJoinedContexts"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
The joined agreements, at most 1,000, in app-id order. Private library,
owner only.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "listParticipants"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: Every participant's account, at most 1,000, in account order.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "listSignatures"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
The saved signatures, at most 1,000, in id order. Private library,
owner only.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "markParticipantSigned"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Confirms the CALLER's signature is on a document: `Forbidden` without
consent, `Invalid` if they have not signed it. Writes nothing.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "registerSelfAsParticipant"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Joins the agreement as `Sign` (v1: after redeeming an open invitation).
Members of the organization only (a guest gets `Forbidden`), not after
an admin removed you (`Forbidden`), and once (`Conflict`). Emits
`ParticipantJoined`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "removeParticipant"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Removes a participant, and keeps them from registering again. Admins
only (`Forbidden`); `NotFound` for someone who is not one; `Conflict`
for the last admin. Emits `ParticipantLeft`.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "resolvePrivateIdentity"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
The private identity behind a shared one, if recorded. Private library,
owner only.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "searchDocumentByEmbedding"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
The most relevant passages of a document for a query embedding, as
text: by chunk when the document has chunks, else by its whole-document
embedding. `NotFound` for an unknown document; `Invalid` for a document
with nothing to search or an embedding of another dimension.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "setConsent"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Records the CALLER's consent to sign a document. Nobody can consent for
you, so there is no account parameter.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "setParticipantPermission"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Changes an existing participant's level, up or down. Admins only
(`Forbidden`); `NotFound` for someone who is not one; `Conflict` for the
last admin stepping down. Setting the level they hold is a no-op.
Emits `ParticipantPermissionChanged`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "setup"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Makes this instance a private library (`isPrivate`) or a shared
agreement named `contextName` (v1's `init(is_private, context_name)`).
The app's owner only (`Forbidden`), once (`Conflict`). A shared
agreement's owner is its first admin.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "signDocument"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Records the CALLER's signature: the PDF at the document's current
version (`baseHash`) with their mark on it, uploaded as blob
`pdfBlobIdStr`, is the document's new version `newHash`. `Sign` or
above (`Forbidden`), after consenting (`Forbidden`); `Conflict` for a
fully signed document, a second signature, or a `baseHash` that is no
longer current (someone signed in between: reopen and sign again).
Emits `DocumentSigned`.

post.description:
A call: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` with `method: "uploadDocument"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description:
Adds a document the caller uploaded as blob `pdfBlobIdStr` and returns
its id. `Sign` or above (`Forbidden`). Its required signers are every
participant at `Sign` or above now (at most 1,000). Emits
`DocumentUploaded`.

post.description:
A view: runs as `POST /apps/{app}/views` with `method: "whoami"`.

The ABI lists the app's errors for the whole app, not per method: any of them may answer `422 APP_ERROR`.
post.x-calimero-publisher-description: The caller's account, as this contract sees it.

tags.description: Writes: each runs once, in order, through the app's log.
tags.name: call

tags.description: Reads: answered from the app's state without writing.
tags.name: view

tags.description: The app's committed events, then live.
tags.name: events
